_about: Frozen inputs for the April 23, 2026 BANR takeout memo. build_takeout.py uses this file by default so a rebuild reproduces the published figures exactly; pass --live to re-pull SEC EDGAR + Yahoo Finance data instead. Values match banr_takeout_analysis.xlsx as built on April 23, 2026.
revision_note: Text and formatting revised October 2026; acquirer asset sizes corrected to each bank's SEC filings available on April 23, 2026. Valuation figures unchanged from April 23, 2026.

other_intangibles_not_deducted.note: EDGAR tag OtherIntangibleAssetsNet at 2025-12-31. The pipeline looks for IntangibleAssetsNetExcludingGoodwill, which Banner does not report, so this amount was not deducted (about $0.04 per share of TBV).
